topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a folded piece of paper tucked away in a drawer we both use, hidden under some old receipts and forgotten knick-knacks. As I unfolded it, a list of items caught my eye—each one written in my partner’s unmistakable handwriting. It was their bucket list, a collection of dreams and aspirations, some big, some small. My hands trembled as I read through the neatly penned items, each one a whisper of what they truly want from life. I wonder if they know I found it. I feel the weight of each unfinished dream pressing down on me, as if the paper itself is a ledger of secrets and silent hopes.
